The '''''Overt''''' was a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] training vessel in service between [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]] to [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kan Pojo]] was the range officer and small-arms instructor onboard.
